summary: Phase 2 FY testing complete (Advances, Invoices, TDS Register, Bank Guarantees). Backend: 11/12 pytest cases PASS. UI: global FY selector propagates to inline selectors on all four pages; row counts change correctly. TDS local FY (data-testid='tds-fy') and BG local FY (data-testid='bg-filter-fy') both sync to global header FY. Invoices CSV export includes 'Financial Year' column and respects fy. Advances/Invoices FY endpoints properly enforce center-scope isolation for the accountant user. ONE SECURITY ISSUE FOUND (pre-existing but in Phase-2 scope): /api/bank-guarantees and /api/bank-guarantees/summary DO NOT enforce center-scope isolation — the center-scoped accountant (mapped to center 9cf18e69) sees BGs from center 4d7fc745 both with and without fy param. Backend code (server.py list_bank_guarantees ~L19731 and bg_summary ~L19777) only requires BG_ROLES and never applies center/company scope filtering.

critical.issue: No center-scope isolation. Center-scoped accountant (test_center_manager_c6912430@x.com, mapped only to center 9cf18e69-312d-488d-a484-2d68d62d48a7) receives BGs whose center_id=4d7fc745-c28c-4298-baab-58c63dbe8734. This is not FY-bypass (leak occurs with and without fy) — the endpoints lack center scoping altogether. Similar risk should be audited on other BG endpoints (POST/PATCH/DELETE, /bank-guarantees/{id}).

context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase-2 FY UI flows verified working (Advances, Invoices, TDS Register, Bank Guarantees) — global FY switcher updates inline selectors and re-fetches. Invoice CSV includes Financial Year column. Remaining critical bug: BG list & summary endpoints skip center-scope filtering (see backend/server.py L19731+ and L19777+). Fix pattern: reuse _apply_center_scope logic from list_advance_requests / _build_invoice_query.
rca of the issue: list_bank_guarantees and bg_summary construct a raw Mongo query that only applies is_deleted, is_renewed, and optional center_id/project_id/fy filters — no automatic center-scope enforcement based on the caller's assigned_center_ids. Any authenticated BG_ROLES user therefore sees all centers' BGs. Reproduction: POST /api/auth/login with test_center_manager_c6912430@x.com; GET /api/bank-guarantees?fy=2026-27 returns 2 BGs with center_id=4d7fc745 while the user is mapped to 9cf18e69. Mitigation: on entry, apply the caller's assigned_center_ids as a mandatory {'$in': [...]} filter on q['center_id'] whenever user.role is not admin/global; do the same in bg_summary. Also verify GET/PATCH/DELETE by id perform an ownership check.
